meta.subject: fix addressing issue for wide writes

en.summary: Fixes external-memory address scaling for wide writes by using a different virtual-address stride for full-width accumulator rows than for narrower projected-weight rows.
why_it_counts: The patch changes Scratchpad write-request address generation on an active DUT DMA path.
The bug directly affects where wide writes land in external memory.
The commit message explicitly identifies an addressing issue for wide writes.
evidence: Scratchpad introduces vaddr_offset as a Mux keyed by writeData_is_full_width.
The full-width branch shifts by log2Ceil(config.DIM * config.weightTypeProjected.getWidth / 8).
The pre-fix code always shifted by the / 4 scaling, regardless of whether the write was full width.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A moveout path that can emit both full-width accumulator rows and narrower projected rows must scale logical addresses by different physical byte strides. This bug came from using the narrow-format stride for every write, including full-width rows. On any DUT with multiple store formats sharing one address generator, that mistake will place the wider format at the wrong external-memory offset.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A store or moveout operation emits full-width accumulator data on a path that also supports narrower packed rows.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Force the address generator to reuse the narrow-row byte stride for full-width writes instead of switching to the larger full-width stride.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse narrow-format address scaling for a wider write format
portability_notes: This fault is portable to any DMA writer that accepts one logical row index but supports several physical row widths.
The bug is distinct from request-length bugs: keep transfer length correct and mutate only the base-address scaling.
If your DUT uses byte-address arithmetic instead of shift-based scaling, inject the same error by multiplying by the wrong bytes-per-row constant.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that converts a logical row address or row index into an external-memory byte address for storeback or moveout.
Identify the branch that handles the widest output format and replace its bytes-per-row scaling with the scaling used for the narrower format.
Leave data packing and transfer length unchanged so the failure appears as misplaced writes rather than malformed payload size.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad spad_writer virtual-address generation for full-width versus projected writes
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a format-dependent vaddr_offset Mux so full-width writes use a different shift amount than projected-width writes before tl_ext_mem_base is ORed in.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the spad_writer request builder, remove the vaddr_offset Mux and restore the old single shift amount based on the projected-width /4 scaling for every write.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Full-width writes land at the wrong external-memory addresses, corrupting moveout layout or overwriting adjacent rows.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is localized to the computed vaddr offset for spad_writer requests.
Only the full-width branch changes; the narrow projected-width path remains on the previous scaling.
The patched value is ORed directly into the outgoing external-memory request address.
notes: This is a clean address-generation mutation independent of DMA length changes.
The bug is most visible when exercising full-width accumulator moveout.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 wide write 的外部内存地址缩放错误：full-width 累加器行和更窄的 projected-weight 行应使用不同的虚拟地址步长。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了实际 DUT DMA 写路径上的 Scratchpad 写请求地址生成逻辑。
该错误会直接影响 wide write 在外部内存中的落点。
提交信息明确指出是 wide writes 的 addressing issue。
evidence: Scratchpad 新增了由 writeData_is_full_width 驱动的 vaddr_offset Mux。
full-width 分支使用 log2Ceil(config.DIM * config.weightTypeProjected.getWidth / 8) 进行位移。
修复前无论是否 full width，代码都统一使用 / 4 的缩放。
spad_writer.module.io.req.bits.vaddr 现在使用 config.tl_ext_mem_base.U | vaddr_offset。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一条既能写 full-width 累加器行、又能写更窄 projected 行的 moveout 路径，必须按不同的物理字节步长来缩放逻辑地址。这个错误的根因是：所有写请求都错误复用了窄格式的地址步长，包括 full-width 行。任何在同一个地址生成器上复用多种 store 格式的 DUT，都可能因此把较宽格式写到错误的外部内存偏移。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按格式区分的外部内存地址步长生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: store 或 moveout 在一条同时支持 full-width 累加器数据和更窄打包行的路径上发出 full-width 写。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让地址生成器在 full-width 写上继续复用窄行格式的字节步长，而不是切换到更大的 full-width 步长。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 对更宽写格式复用窄格式地址缩放
portability_notes: 凡是 DMA writer 接受一个逻辑行号、但支持多种物理行宽的设计，都可以移植这类错误。
它与请求长度错误不同：保持传输长度正确，只篡改基地址缩放。
如果你的 DUT 使用字节地址乘法而不是移位缩放，就通过使用错误的 bytes-per-row 常量来注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位把逻辑行地址或行索引转换成外部内存字节地址的 storeback/moveout 地址生成逻辑。
找到处理最宽输出格式的分支，并把它的 bytes-per-row 缩放替换为较窄格式所使用的缩放。
保持数据打包和传输长度逻辑不变，使错误表现为写入位置错误，而不是负载大小异常。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scratchpad 中针对 full-width 与 projected 写的 spad_writer 虚拟地址生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增了按格式选择的 vaddr_offset Mux，使 full-width 写在并入 tl_ext_mem_base 之前使用不同于 projected-width 写的位移量。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 spad_writer 的请求构造逻辑中，删除 vaddr_offset Mux，恢复旧的单一位移量，让所有写都按 projected-width /4 缩放。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: full-width 写会落到错误的外部内存地址，导致 moveout 布局损坏或覆盖相邻行。
evidence_for_injection: 修复只作用于 spad_writer 请求的 vaddr 偏移计算。
真正变化的是 full-width 分支；窄 projected-width 路径仍沿用原来的缩放。
补丁计算出的值会直接并入最终发出的外部内存请求地址。
notes: 这是一个与 DMA 长度变化相互独立的干净地址生成变异点。
在 full-width accumulator moveout 场景下该错误最容易暴露。
